newsitem.title: USA: Colorado River hydropower runoff forecast raised.
newsitem.headline: Colorado River hydropower runoff forecast raised.

text.p: With the onset of additional late spring snowfall in the Colorado River Basin, runoff is projected at 155 percent of normal, or around 12 million acre feet for April through July, the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation said Friday.
The update compares with a mid-April runoff forecast of 142 percent of average.
The Bureau said flows through hydroelectric power dams on the Lower Colorado River will remain near current levels through early June.
Releases through Hoover Dam are expected to average 21,200 cubic feet per second through Friday, falling to 16,300 cfs over the weekend.
Flows through Glen Canyon dam were scheduled to average 21,000 cfs through June 8.
